name: Khaubekho
backstory: Child of Khaubaluk and Aurekhobo in Gorff; raised alongside drives a caravan up and down the transit..., having heard about Birth Of Farmuken.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Heard that Aureluko and Mekhaubo now have a child, Mekaurelo.
Grew up hearing: Learned that Aurebalo has died.
Grew up hearing: Heard that Aurekomest and Aurelkhau now have a child, Aureskomest.

Grew up hearing: Heard that Aurebako and Khaoboro now have a child, Khaobako.

criterion.standard: counts it worthwhile only by paying real attention to Birth Of Darnukas
criterion.wasted_life: letting Birth Of Darnukas slip past unexamined, the way it's easiest to
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

arc.premise: Khaubekho has stopped waiting for the arrears dispute to close on paper and started organizing a joint repair crew from his own family's trades - smiths, masons, drivers - to fix the tollhouse's own neglected upkeep the dispute has been used as an excuse to put off.
